findings.reason: Independently viewed all four original 1200x1400 tiles at original resolution. Tile 03 shows literal dollar delimiters and TeX commands in the uppercase technique banner; the same notation in the proof body is typeset correctly. The renderer treats this banner as plain text.
findings.action: Replaced only the three mathematical snippets in the technique banner with equivalent prose: the curvature parameter; the comparison cotangent times the difference between the metric and the tensor square of the distance differential; and the orthogonal decomposition into the normal hyperplane and real radial line.

correction: Plain-prose workaround for a plain-text proof-technique banner; no mathematical statement or proof-step edits.
remaining_issues: Renderer limitation remains: technique banners render as plain React text with CSS uppercase rather than parsing inline mathematics; the assigned item now avoids math markup there.

native_preview.result: The corrected banner is readable prose with no literal dollar signs or TeX commands, fits within the item width, and remains distinct from the typeset proof steps.
native_preview.capture_note: Initial preview completed and produced its manifest, HTML, snapshot and four PNG tiles. A redundant second invocation was refused because the output directory already existed; it did not overwrite the successful preview.
native_preview.limitations: Local ItemBody preview, not production HTTP-route coverage.
